description: ContainerHub's own Renovate config. Everything that is not specific to THIS repo now lives in the shared preset at the repository root (default.json), so the consumers get the same rules by extending one line - most importantly the git-submodules manager, which Renovate disables by default and which is why this repo's own third_party/DocumANTation pin went unwatched.
Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ContainerHub` from the DEFAULT BRANCH even for this repository, so a default.json change is not exercised by the PR that makes it; it takes effect after merge.

packageRules.description: versions.env keys are notification-only: a bump requires the human ritual (sync_versions.py --write + refreshing the *_SHA256 pins per AGENTS.md § Version Bumping), so never auto-PR them.
Dockerfile digest updates (UBUNTU_DIGEST-style FROM pins) also need sync_versions.py --write to propagate; require dashboard approval.

customManagers.description: versions.env keys annotated with a renovate hint comment: # renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name> [extractVersion=...]
